newsitem.title: UK: Algeria to sell April oil at Brent +38/42 cts - trade.
newsitem.headline: Algeria to sell April oil at Brent +38/42 cts - trade.

text.p: Algeria has agreed contract prices for April sales of its Saharan Blend oil at between 38 and 42 cents over Dated Brent, traders said on Monday.
The lower numbers would be for earlier loading dates in April while the more expensive differentials would be for later in the month, they said.
The reduction from levels of Dated +79 cents agreed in March reflects the oil complex's move into contango, traders said.
Sales were priced at Dated Brent +78 and +79 cents for February and +73 and +74 cents for January.
Sonatrach officials could not immediately be contacted for comment.
